s0301.literal: That night Mars, Venus, and Saturn — three stars — gathered at Stomach.
s0301.idiomatic: That night Mars, Venus, and Saturn — 3 stars — gathered at Stomach.

s0302.literal: On bingyin day the Hanlin National History Office presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Renzong.
s0302.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Hanlin National History Office presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Renzong.

s0303.literal: Jiaohua and others were dispatched to the Western Tibetans to pacify newly submitted people, collect livestock taxes, and repair relay stations.
s0303.idiomatic: Jiaohua and others were dispatched to the Western Tibetans to pacify newly submitted people, collect livestock taxes, and repair relay stations.

s0304.literal: On wuchen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.
s0304.idiomatic: On wuchen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.

s0305.literal: On the Heavenly Longevity Festival, Bindan, Java, and other states dispatched envoys presenting tribute.
s0305.idiomatic: On the Heavenly Longevity Festival, Bindan, Java, and other states dispatched envoys presenting tribute.

s0306.literal: On jisi day nineteen sluice gates of the Tonghui Canal were repaired.
s0306.idiomatic: On jisi day 19 sluice gates of the Tonghui Canal were repaired.

s0307.literal: The Yehu and Sanggan roads were repaired.
s0307.idiomatic: The Yehu and Sanggan roads were repaired.

s0308.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor hunted at Willow Grove and, turning to Baizhu, said: "Recently the earth has been unquiet and wind and rain untimely — could it be that in succeeding to the great inheritance there are shortcomings in my conduct?
s0308.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor hunted at Willow Grove and, turning to Baizhu, said, "Recently the earth has been unquiet and wind and rain untimely — could it be that in succeeding to the great inheritance there are shortcomings in my conduct?

s0309.literal: " In reply he said: "Earthquakes have existed since antiquity; Your Majesty's self-reproach is indeed fitting, but it is truly because we, your ministers, have failed in our duties and could not harmonize and govern.
s0309.idiomatic: In reply he said, "Earthquakes have existed since antiquity; Your Majesty's self-reproach is indeed fitting, but it is truly because we, your ministers, have failed in our duties and could not harmonize and govern.

s0310.literal: " The Emperor said: "In three years on the throne, among the myriad people and all things, could there be nothing discordant?
s0310.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "In 3 years on the throne, among the myriad people and all things, could there be nothing discordant?

s0311.literal: You and others should deliberate with the hundred officials; whatever benefits the people and serves the common good, I shall immediately carry out.
s0311.idiomatic: You and others should deliberate with the hundred officials; whatever benefits the people and serves the common good, I shall immediately carry out.

s0312.literal: " Offices of the princely tutor for Prince Yebogan of Zhenyuan were established.
s0312.idiomatic: Offices of the princely tutor for Prince Yebogan of Zhenyuan were established.

s0313.literal: One chief official post of Huangping Prefecture in Bozhou was abolished, and its people were relocated under Huangping.
s0313.idiomatic: One chief official post of Huangping Prefecture in Bozhou was abolished, and its people were relocated under Huangping.

s0314.literal: That night Venus transgressed Hairy Head.
s0314.idiomatic: That night Venus transgressed Hairy Head.

s0315.literal: On xinsi day the five regalia carriages were made.
s0315.idiomatic: On xinsi day the 5 regalia carriages were made.

s0316.literal: Minister of Education Liu Kui and Xuanzheng Bureau associate commissioner Nanggatai, for falsely presenting land and improperly taking government funds, were executed.
s0316.idiomatic: Minister of Education Liu Kui and Xuanzheng Bureau associate commissioner Nanggatai, for falsely presenting land and improperly taking government funds, were executed.

s0317.literal: Precedent regulations were finalized — altogether two thousand five hundred thirty-nine articles, including seven hundred seventeen adjudication precedents, one thousand one hundred fifty-one clause regulations, ninety-four amnesties and edicts, and five hundred seventy-seven ordinance categories — entitled Comprehensive Statutes of the Great Yuan, and promulgated throughout the realm.
s0317.idiomatic: Precedent regulations were finalized — altogether 2,539 articles, including 717 adjudication precedents, 1,151 clause regulations, 94 amnesties and edicts, and 577 ordinance categories — entitled Comprehensive Statutes of the Great Yuan, and promulgated throughout the realm.

s0318.literal: That night the moon transgressed East Saltern.
s0318.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed East Saltern.

s0319.literal: On guiwei day two hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes and twenty thousand shi of grain were granted to relieve the northern frontier armies.
s0319.idiomatic: On guiwei day 250,000 ingots of notes and 20,000 shi of grain were granted to relieve the northern frontier armies.

s0320.literal: The Xuanhui Bureau was ordered to select four hundred Mongol youths for household guard service.
s0320.idiomatic: The Xuanhui Bureau was ordered to select 400 Mongol youths for household guard service.

s0321.literal: Three overall directorates of the Xuanzheng Bureau were abolished: the capital overall directorate was placed under the relevant office, and the qielian and craftsmen overall directorates were placed under the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
s0321.idiomatic: 3 overall directorates of the Xuanzheng Bureau were abolished: the capital overall directorate was placed under the relevant office, and the qielian and craftsmen overall directorates were placed under the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

s0322.literal: Kaicheng Route was reduced to a prefecture.
s0322.idiomatic: Kaicheng Route was reduced to a prefecture.

s0323.literal: On bingxu day earth fell like rain.
s0323.idiomatic: On bingxu day earth fell like rain.

s0324.literal: The capital suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief sale.
s0324.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain were issued for relief sale.

s0325.literal: The flags of the five regalia carriages were made.
s0325.idiomatic: The flags of the 5 regalia carriages were made.

s0326.literal: On dinghai day an edict directed that two sets of the gold-written Buddhist canon be made, with Baizhu and others placed in overall charge.
s0326.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed that 2 sets of the gold-written Buddhist canon be made, with Baizhu and others placed in overall charge.

s0327.literal: On wuwu day Yingshi Buhua was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao State.
s0327.idiomatic: On wuwu day Yingshi Buhua was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao State.

s0328.literal: On xinmao day, because crown prince guest Bodulian was impoverished, one hundred thousand strings of notes were granted.
s0328.idiomatic: On xinmao day, because crown prince guest Bodulian was impoverished, 100,000 strings of notes were granted.

s0329.literal: Prince Yesi Bie dispatched envoys to court.
s0329.idiomatic: Prince Yesi Bie dispatched envoys to court.

s0330.literal: The Chenghai pacification commission and myriarch office were abolished, and a garrison-farm overall directorate was established in their place.
s0330.idiomatic: The Chenghai pacification commission and myriarch office were abolished, and a garrison-farm overall directorate was established in their place.

s0331.literal: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.
s0331.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.

s0332.literal: When sea-transport grain arrived at Zhigu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea goddess Tianfei.
s0332.idiomatic: When sea-transport grain arrived at Zhigu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea goddess Tianfei.

s0333.literal: Third month, on renchen new moon, the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.
s0333.idiomatic: Third month, on renchen new moon, the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

s0334.literal: Prince Nandashi was granted two million five hundred thousand strings of notes, and Prince Tuohuan's annual grant was restored.
s0334.idiomatic: Prince Nandashi was granted 2,500,000 strings of notes, and Prince Tuohuan's annual grant was restored.

s0335.literal: On dingyou day Jiading Prefecture in Pingjiang Route suffered famine; sixty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0335.idiomatic: On dingyou day Jiading Prefecture in Pingjiang Route suffered famine; 60,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0336.literal: On wuxu day the Jurchen households of the Shaopi garrison farm in Anfeng suffered famine; grain was granted for one month.
s0336.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Jurchen households of the Shaopi garrison farm in Anfeng suffered famine; grain was granted for 1 month.

s0337.literal: On gengzi day Chongming and other prefectures suffered famine; eighteen thousand three hundred shi of rice were issued for relief.
s0337.idiomatic: On gengzi day Chongming and other prefectures suffered famine; 18,300 shi of rice were issued for relief.

s0338.literal: On jiachen day Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Route suffered famine; grain was granted for two months.
s0338.idiomatic: On jiachen day Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Route suffered famine; grain was granted for 2 months.

s0339.literal: On dingwei day the Canbolang tribes of the Western Tibetans rebelled; Western Pacification Martial Restraint Prince Tuosiban and others were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.
s0339.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Canbolang tribes of the Western Tibetans rebelled; Western Pacification Martial Restraint Prince Tuosiban and others were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.

s0340.literal: On wushen day the Grand Empress Dowager was enshrined in Emperor Shunzong's temple chamber; Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies and central secretariat right chancellor Baizhu was dispatched bearing the jade register and jade seal to confer the honorific title Empress Zhao Xian Yuan Sheng.
s0340.idiomatic: On wushen day the Grand Empress Dowager was enshrined in Emperor Shunzong's temple chamber; Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies and central secretariat right chancellor Baizhu was dispatched bearing the jade register and jade seal to confer the honorific title Empress Zhao Xian Yuan Sheng.

s0341.literal: On xinhai day, because of the disorder of Yuanming and Wang Daoming, Buddhist and Daoist ordination certificates and talismans were forbidden.
s0341.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because of the disorder of Yuanming and Wang Daoming, Buddhist and Daoist ordination certificates and talismans were forbidden.

s0342.literal: On bingchen day an edict stated: "Physicians, diviners, and craftsmen officials may not leave office during mourning; at seventy retirement is not permitted; sons and grandsons without hereditary privilege, if able to inherit their craft, shall be appointed according to talent.
s0342.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict stated, "Physicians, diviners, and craftsmen officials may not leave office during mourning; at 70 retirement is not permitted; sons and grandsons without hereditary privilege, if able to inherit their craft, shall be appointed according to talent.

s0343.literal: " Supervising censors Baizhu and Jiaohua, for improperly recommending Basijisi, were both dismissed.
s0343.idiomatic: Supervising censors Baizhu and Jiaohua, for improperly recommending Basijisi, were both dismissed.

s0344.literal: Relay-households of Prince Huoluhui's division army suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0344.idiomatic: Relay-households of Prince Huoluhui's division army suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0345.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renxu new moon, an edict directed all offices throughout the realm to have monks recite one hundred thousand sutra sections.
s0345.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on renxu new moon, an edict directed all offices throughout the realm to have monks recite 100,000 sutra sections.

s0346.literal: On bingyin day relay-households of the Mongol army at Chaghan Na'ur suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0346.idiomatic: On bingyin day relay-households of the Mongol army at Chaghan Na'ur suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0347.literal: On dingmao day chaste widow Wang of Neihuang County was commended.
s0347.idiomatic: On dingmao day chaste widow Wang of Neihuang County was commended.

s0348.literal: On jisi day the Jinshui River was dredged.
s0348.idiomatic: On jisi day the Jinshui River was dredged.

s0349.literal: On jiaxu day Zhang Gui and right secretariat section director Wang Shixi were ordered to encourage study at the Directorate of the National University.
s0349.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhang Gui and right secretariat section director Wang Shixi were ordered to encourage study at the Directorate of the National University.

s0350.literal: An edict directed chief merit commissioner Kuo'erlu to come to the capital.
s0350.idiomatic: An edict directed chief merit commissioner Kuo'erlu to come to the capital.

s0351.literal: Thirty-one prisoners guilty of capital offenses were released, and sixty-nine guilty of beatings of fifty-seven strokes or more.
s0351.idiomatic: 31 prisoners guilty of capital offenses were released, and 69 guilty of beatings of 57 strokes or more.

s0352.literal: One hundred thousand caged birds were released, and the relevant offices were ordered to compensate their value.
s0352.idiomatic: 100,000 caged birds were released, and the relevant offices were ordered to compensate their value.

s0353.literal: On jimao day an edict proclaimed the corvée-assistance law: envoys were dispatched to examine tax registers for high and low assessments; fields of set acreage were assigned to corvée-duty persons to manage in rotation, collecting yearly income to defray corvée expenses — the government was not to participate.
s0353.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict proclaimed the corvée-assistance law: envoys were dispatched to examine tax registers for high and low assessments; fields of set acreage were assigned to corvée-duty persons to manage in rotation, collecting yearly income to defray corvée expenses — the government was not to participate.

s0354.literal: Northern frontier armies suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0354.idiomatic: Northern frontier armies suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0355.literal: The Mongol great qianhu division, whose livestock had perished in wind and snow these past years, was granted two million strings of notes in relief.
s0355.idiomatic: The Mongol great qianhu division, whose livestock had perished in wind and snow these past years, was granted 2,000,000 strings of notes in relief.

s0356.literal: An edict directed the four temples Wan'an, Qing Shou, Sheng'an, and Puqing in the capital, Jinshan Temple on the Yangzi River, and Wansheng Youguo Temple on Wutai to perform seven days and nights of water-and-land Buddhist rites.
s0356.idiomatic: An edict directed the 4 temples Wan'an, Qing Shou, Sheng'an, and Puqing in the capital, Jinshan Temple on the Yangzi River, and Wansheng Youguo Temple on Wutai to perform 7 days and nights of water-and-land Buddhist rites.

s0357.literal: On dinghai day the widow Piaomo of the late Luoluosi pacification commissioner Shugu, acting in charge of the office, dispatched her son Suozhubang to present tribute goods.
s0357.idiomatic: On dinghai day the widow Piaomo of the late Luoluosi pacification commissioner Shugu, acting in charge of the office, dispatched her son Suozhubang to present tribute goods.

s0358.literal: On wuzi day the people of Nanfeng Prefecture and the Mongol army of Gongchang suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0358.idiomatic: On wuzi day the people of Nanfeng Prefecture and the Mongol army of Gongchang suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0359.literal: Fifth month, on xinmao day a salt monopoly tax official was established at Baiyan City in Dali Route, rank 7a;
s0359.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinmao day a salt monopoly tax official was established at Baiyan City in Dali Route, rank 7a;

s0360.literal: a salt monopoly tax official in Zhongqing Route, rank 7b.
s0360.idiomatic: a salt monopoly tax official in Zhongqing Route, rank 7b.

s0361.literal: Anqing Qianshan County and Yunnan Ningyuan Prefecture were established.
s0361.idiomatic: Anqing Qianshan County and Yunnan Ningyuan Prefecture were established.

s0362.literal: On wuxu day Venus crossed the sky.
s0362.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus crossed the sky.

s0363.literal: On gengzi day great wind, rain, and hail uprooted two thousand seven hundred large trees inside and outside the Willow Grove traveling palace.
s0363.idiomatic: On gengzi day great wind, rain, and hail uprooted 2,700 large trees inside and outside the Willow Grove traveling palace.

s0364.literal: On xinchou day Tieshi was entrusted alone with censor-in-chief affairs.
s0364.idiomatic: On xinchou day Tieshi was entrusted alone with censor-in-chief affairs.

s0365.literal: On renyin day Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor Huxin, for corruption, was beaten and dismissed.
s0365.idiomatic: On renyin day Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor Huxin, for corruption, was beaten and dismissed.

s0366.literal: An edict opened the path for memorializing inside and outside the court.
s0366.idiomatic: An edict opened the path for memorializing inside and outside the court.

s0367.literal: Yishan County was established in Qingyuan Route, and one patrol inspector was added.
s0367.idiomatic: Yishan County was established in Qingyuan Route, and 1 patrol inspector was added.

s0368.literal: Anzhai County was relocated to Long'an Post.
s0368.idiomatic: Anzhai County was relocated to Long'an Post.

s0369.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Room.
s0369.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Room.

s0370.literal: On yisi day, because grain was costly in Lingbei, wine-brewing was forbidden.
s0370.idiomatic: On yisi day, because grain was costly in Lingbei, wine-brewing was forbidden.

s0371.literal: On wushen day supervising censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi said: "Tiemudie'er is devious, greedy, and corrupt; we request that the stele erected for him be destroyed.
s0371.idiomatic: On wushen day supervising censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi said, "Tiemudie'er is devious, greedy, and corrupt; we request that the stele erected for him be destroyed.

s0372.literal: " It was approved; official ranks and seals of investiture and posthumous conferral were still revoked.
s0372.idiomatic: It was approved; official ranks and seals of investiture and posthumous conferral were still revoked.

s0373.literal: The Emperor visited the Great Peace Pavilion, saw that the surviving garments of Taizu and Shizu were all of plain silk and cotton, heavily patched and mended, sighed long, and said to attending ministers: "Our founding ancestors' creation of the enterprise was arduous, and their dress and use were this frugal — how dare I forget it for a moment!
s0373.idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Great Peace Pavilion, saw that the surviving garments of Taizu and Shizu were all of plain silk and cotton, heavily patched and mended, sighed long, and said to attending ministers, "Our founding ancestors' creation of the enterprise was arduous, and their dress and use were this frugal — how dare I forget it for a moment!

s0375.literal: On guichou day Jinghu pacification commissioner Tuolie accepted bribes; when the matter came to light he was summoned to the capital; censorate officials requested he be sent back for trial locally — this was not approved.
s0375.idiomatic: On guichou day Jinghu pacification commissioner Tuolie accepted bribes; when the matter came to light he was summoned to the capital; censorate officials requested he be sent back for trial locally — this was not approved.

s0376.literal: On yimao day merit-heirs Sa'ermman, Anhui Temür, and Yesun Temür were each granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
s0376.idiomatic: On yimao day merit-heirs Sa'ermman, Anhui Temür, and Yesun Temür were each granted 15,000 strings of notes.

s0377.literal: Ten million strings of notes were used to purchase sheep and horses for Lingbei frontier garrison soldiers — two gelded horses, two brood mares, and fifteen sheep per man.
s0377.idiomatic: 10 million strings of notes were used to purchase sheep and horses for Lingbei frontier garrison soldiers — 2 gelded horses, 2 brood mares, and 15 sheep per man.

s0378.literal: Relay-households were forbidden to pawn or sell government land without authorization.
s0378.idiomatic: Relay-households were forbidden to pawn or sell government land without authorization.

s0379.literal: On bingchen day Dong'an Prefecture was flooded, ruining one thousand five hundred sixty qing of commoners' fields.
s0379.idiomatic: On bingchen day Dong'an Prefecture was flooded, ruining 1,560 qing of commoners' fields.

s0380.literal: On wuwu day southern Wuyi County in Zhending Route was harmed by floodwaters to the crops.
s0380.idiomatic: On wuwu day southern Wuyi County in Zhending Route was harmed by floodwaters to the crops.

s0381.literal: The main hall of the traveling palace at Fengyuan was destroyed by fire.
s0381.idiomatic: The main hall of the traveling palace at Fengyuan was destroyed by fire.

s0382.literal: The storehouse of the Shangdu Directorate of Utilization caught fire; the Emperor ordered guards to extinguish it.
s0382.idiomatic: The storehouse of the Shangdu Directorate of Utilization caught fire; the Emperor ordered guards to extinguish it.

s0383.literal: He then said to the assembled ministers: "Emperor Shizu first built these palace halls, and down to today we dwell in peace within them.
s0383.idiomatic: He then said to the assembled ministers, "Emperor Shizu first built these palace halls, and down to today we dwell in peace within them.

s0384.literal: Having succeeded to the great inheritance, yet meeting with this destruction — this is because I have been unable to plan good governance.
s0384.idiomatic: Having succeeded to the great inheritance, yet meeting with this destruction — this is because I have been unable to plan good governance.

s0385.literal: " Imperial Bodyguard soldiers garrisoning the frontier — one soldier with accumulated merit requested reward with an official post; the Emperor said: "Are titles and ranks objects with which to reward people?
s0385.idiomatic: Imperial Bodyguard soldiers garrisoning the frontier — 1 soldier with accumulated merit requested reward with an official post; the Emperor said, "Are titles and ranks objects with which to reward people?

s0386.literal: " An order granted him three thousand strings of notes.
s0386.idiomatic: An order granted him 3,000 strings of notes.

s0387.literal: Weixian in Daming Route had prolonged rain; Yansmen garrison farm in Datong Route suffered drought damage to wheat; various guard garrison farms and Yongqing County had flooding; Guixin County in Baoding Route had locusts.
s0387.idiomatic: Weixian in Daming Route had prolonged rain; Yansmen garrison farm in Datong Route suffered drought damage to wheat; various guard garrison farms and Yongqing County had flooding; Guixin County in Baoding Route had locusts.

s0388.literal: Sixth month, bandits besieged Ningdu; commoner Sun Zhengchen of the prefecture supplied grain to the army — his gate was commended.
s0388.idiomatic: Sixth month, bandits besieged Ningdu; commoner Sun Zhengchen of the prefecture supplied grain to the army — his gate was commended.

s0389.literal: On dingmao day the Canbolang bandits of the Western Tibetans were not yet pacified; Xuanzheng commissioner Choulu was dispatched to oversee the army.
s0389.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Canbolang bandits of the Western Tibetans were not yet pacified; Xuanzheng commissioner Choulu was dispatched to oversee the army.

s0390.literal: On wuchen day the steles of Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather were destroyed, the original seals of investiture were recovered, and proclamation was made to inner and outer.
s0390.idiomatic: On wuchen day the steles of Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather were destroyed, the original seals of investiture were recovered, and proclamation was made to inner and outer.

s0391.literal: Wet nurse Hututai was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Dingxiang Commandery; her husband Alai was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Dingxiang with the posthumous title Zhong Min.
s0391.idiomatic: Wet nurse Hututai was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Dingxiang Commandery; her husband Alai was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Dingxiang with the posthumous title Zhong Min.

s0392.literal: On renshen day Construction Bureau commissioner Hasar Buqa, for deceiving the throne and seeking profit, was beaten and banished to the eastern frontier; his household was confiscated.
s0392.idiomatic: On renshen day Construction Bureau commissioner Hasar Buqa, for deceiving the throne and seeking profit, was beaten and banished to the eastern frontier; his household was confiscated.

s0393.literal: The capital garrison office, because of rain, requested capital repairs; an order stated: "This year large earthworks should not be undertaken; merely make basic repairs.
s0393.idiomatic: The capital garrison office, because of rain, requested capital repairs; an order stated, "This year large earthworks should not be undertaken; merely make basic repairs.

s0394.literal: " On guiyou day side chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were established.
s0394.idiomatic: On guiyou day side chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were established.

s0395.literal: Yanchi Jitai's Tai Chi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xiang'an.
s0395.idiomatic: Yanchi Jitai's Tai Chi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xiang'an.

s0396.literal: Prince Biesi Temür commanded troops in the northern region and was separately granted an annual stipend.
s0396.idiomatic: Prince Biesi Temür commanded troops in the northern region and was separately granted an annual stipend.

s0397.literal: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau requested compilation of rites of successive reigns — this was approved.
s0397.idiomatic: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau requested compilation of rites of successive reigns — this was approved.

s0398.literal: On guiwei day Saturn transgressed Net.
s0398.idiomatic: On guiwei day Saturn transgressed Net.

s0399.literal: On yiyou day Yi, An, Cang, Mo, Ba, and Qi prefectures and various guard garrison farms were flooded, ruining more than six thousand qing of fields.
s0399.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yi, An, Cang, Mo, Ba, and Qi prefectures and various guard garrison farms were flooded, ruining more than 6,000 qing of fields.

s0400.literal: Prince Qiebo had repeatedly raided the frontier; now he dispatched envoys to submit; the Emperor said: "I do not desire their land and people — only that our people not suffer frontier calamity and soldiers be spared labor and corvée — that is happiness enough.
s0400.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo had repeatedly raided the frontier; now he dispatched envoys to submit; the Emperor said, "I do not desire their land and people — only that our people not suffer frontier calamity and soldiers be spared labor and corvée — that is happiness enough.
